update.sql: WITH __umf_selected AS (SELECT `r`.`id` AS `id`, `r`.`status` AS `status` FROM `__umf_delta_stage` AS `r` WHERE (`r`.`status` = :p1) ORDER BY `r`.`id` ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 3) SELECT rows.`id`, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __umf_selected selected WHERE selected.`id` <=> rows.`id`) THEN :p2 ELSE rows.`status` END AS `status` FROM `__umf_delta_stage` rows

verification.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS violations FROM `__umf_delta_before` before FULL OUTER JOIN `__umf_delta_stage` rows ON before.`id` <=> rows.`id` WHERE before.`id` IS NULL OR rows.`id` IS NULL OR NOT (rows.`id` <=> before.`id`) OR NOT (rows.`status` <=> CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `__umf_delta_selected` s WHERE s.`id` <=> before.`id`) THEN :p1 ELSE before.`status` END)
